Awaits a JavaScript promise from Kotlin, hands a Deferred to a script as a promise, binds host functions that suspend, and cancels a running script when the calling coroutine is cancelled. The engine runs on a dispatcher that handles one call at a time, as JavaScript itself does.

        z-rpc / z-oss / z-schedule / z-msg / z-script / z-ctc / z-util / L3 Agent-AI 7 仓) 的版本权威。
        与 z-boot-dependencies (第三方地板) 分家:抬任何一格兄弟仓版本只需要重发本 pom 一个文件夹,

        所以钉在 z-boot-parent。本文件由 _doc/003_script/gen_fleet_bom.py
        生成 —— 坐标清单取自兄弟仓盘上的 pom,版本逐件对 repo1 复核过,别手改。

io.github.shrinivas93:rest-in-peace-spring-boot-starter 1.0.0.55 发布, Spring Boot auto-configuration for REST-in-peace: auto-registers every
		@RestClient interface found on the classpath as a Spring bean, instead
		of one hand-written @Bean method per interface. See
		docs/design/spring-boot-starter.md in the parent repository for the
		full design and rollout plan. A sibling reactor module of core/ (not
		a dependent of it in the reactor sense - it resolves core the same
		way a real downstream consumer would, as an ordinary Maven
		dependency), sharing core's version and release cadence via their
		common parent. Requires Java 17+ and Spring Boot 4.x; the core
		rest-in-peace library itself stays on Java 8.
